findings.recommendation: Site-to-site IPsec needs UDP 500 (IKE) and UDP 4500 (NAT traversal) between the VPN peers; the tunnel drops at the next rekey. Remove the deny or scope it away from the VPN peer addresses, then confirm with netops-hybrid-health.
findings.remediation_script:
# Human review required. Read-only verification (the agent never runs writes):
az network nsg rule list -g rg-netops-onprem --nsg-name nsg-netops-onprem-outside --include-default -o table
az network nsg rule show -g rg-netops-onprem --nsg-name nsg-netops-onprem-outside -n sc02-block-ike -o json
# Change (review before running):
# az network nsg rule delete -g rg-netops-onprem --nsg-name nsg-netops-onprem-outside -n sc02-block-ike
findings.title: NSG nsg-netops-onprem-outside: rule sc02-block-ike blocks IKE/IPsec (UDP 500/4500) inbound

findings.recommendation: NSG rules are processed in priority order and processing stops at the first match. Re-order or narrow the higher-priority rule if the lower one is still intended; otherwise remove the dead rule.
findings.remediation_script:

findings.title: NSG nsg-netops-onprem-outside: Allow rule allow-ipsec-inbound (1000) never matches; Deny rule sc02-block-ike (100) is evaluated first and covers it
